scripts.build:lib: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir dist --target browser --production --banner="/* Made by tinnyterr (tinnyterr@tinnyterr.com) Licenced under GPL-3.0-only */" --format esm -e mermaid && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.build:cli: bun build ./index.ts --outfile dist/cli.js --target bun --production --banner="/* Made by tinnyterr (tinnyterr@tinnyterr.com) Licenced under GPL-3.0-only */" --format esm -e mermaid && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun run build:lib && bun run build:cli
scripts.build:web: bun build ./src/index.ts --outfile dist/web/syrup.esm.js --production --banner="/* Made by tinnyterr (tinnyterr@tinnyterr.com) Licenced under GPL-3.0-only */" --target browser --format esm --minify && bun build ./web/global.ts --outfile dist/web/syrup.js --target browser --format iife --minify && bun build ./web/demo.tsx --outfile dist/web/demo.js --target browser --format esm --minify
scripts.build:editors: (cd obsidian && bun install && bun run build) && (cd vscode && bun run package)
